description: Marked or unmarked law-enforcement patrol cars
complianceNotes: Fleet inspection per local agency policy; dash-cam data retention compliance

description: Officer body cameras for evidence capture
complianceNotes: Data retention per jurisdiction FOI/FOIA policy; chain-of-custody logging

description: Portable and mobile radio communications equipment
complianceNotes: FCC or local spectrum licence compliance; encryption enabled

description: Service weapons including handguns, rifles, and shotguns
complianceNotes: Serial-number audit annually; armoury log per draw/return; qualification records

description: Body armour, ballistic helmets, shields, and riot gear
complianceNotes: Ballistic rating certification; replace per manufacturer expiry date
ITAR-controlled items tracked separately where applicable

description: Crime-scene evidence collection and analysis kits
complianceNotes: Chain-of-custody seals; expiry tracking on reagents

description: Fire engines, rescue trucks, command vehicles
complianceNotes: NFPA 1911 annual pump test; aerial device inspection

description: Unmanned aerial systems for surveillance, search-and-rescue, or mapping
complianceNotes: FAA Part 107 or local RPAS regulations; flight-log retention

description: CCTV cameras, ANPR systems, and monitoring stations
complianceNotes: Privacy-impact assessment required; data retention per local policy
